title: Localization costs and information growth for exact Gaussian observations
main_claim: Theorem ld:thm:main. Take Z uniform on the cube chart Q_0, with S=phi(Z), and observe t blocks of k=floor(n/16) exact Gaussian measurements. If each block sends a message with N values satisfying (2/m+e^{-ck})log N <= C_0 d, then one can also reveal nested dyadic cells containing Z so that the augmented transcript satisfies I(Z;Pi_t) <= C(C_0) d t and E J_t <= Ct. Corollary ld:cor:streaming: a learner with M=o(d^2) bits of memory that succeeds with probability at least 2/3 for every signal needs T >= c d log(1/epsilon) samples.
coverage:
I read the introduction, Section 1 (model, Lemmas l:borel, l:prior-ac, l:caps-endpoint and the endpoint constants) and all of Section 2 (the dyadic route), and checked every step of the main theorem and its corollary.

Projection lemma (ld:lem:density):
- Tube bound: the covering count C^n, the choice of scale 2^{-l} <= delta, and the q <= m-2 exponent all check.
- Replica moment: the intersection of the smoothing boxes, the Gaussian density bound for the difference vector with covariance D^T D (so eta cancels), and the Gram-Schmidt product V_* = prod D_i check.
- Tail: the Cauchy-Schwarz step gives the delta^{gamma/2} tail. I verified gamma/2 - k >= n/8 + 1 for k=floor(n/16), m=floor(n/8). The layer-cake integral, the integration order, and the exact-label limit by duality also check.

One-block lemma (ld:lem:block):
- The Gaussian tail constant 1 - (log 2)/2 is right, and in fact ||a|| <= 1.
- The Holder test against the reference probabilities b_w checks, and so does the L^2 duality.
- The Jensen bound 2P_w log(||p_w||_2/P_w), the log-sum and entropy algebra, and the G=0 term bounded by e^{-ck} log N all check.

Heavy-cell lemma (ld:lem:heavy):
- The depth bound from lambda <= mu_0/p, and the spread of the conditional law using the selection probability p_R, check.
- The count of at most 2^{alpha n j} heavy cells, the geometric-comparison bound on the depth entropy, and the tail bound E log B_U <= H(j)+1 check.

Closing the theorem:
- The chain-rule sum, including the telescoping of E log B_{i-1}, gives the depth coefficient (alpha n + 2) log 2.
- The exact identity KL = nJ_t log 2 + KL to the restricted measure gives the lower bound. Since E J_t is finite, the two bounds can be combined.

Corollary:
- The block alphabet (k+3)2^M+1, the cap volume bound (2 pi e)^{n/2} <= 5^n, and the binary data-processing step check.
- The endpoint T > d/8 (success at most 5/8 otherwise) checks, and it removes the ceiling in t = ceil(T/k).

Not audited: the eight alternative localization routes (the sections under drafts/*) and the two information-correction sections (13 kernel potential, 14 cell correction), including their dependence on the companion articles OpenAIReplica2026 and OpenAIRow2026.
